description: A choice point now looks like this: the whole choice point (4, third rule), pending until the server acknowledges it (5), and marked removing while it waits out an undo window.

day.description: The journal day the choice point is kept with, as its date; it never changes.

situation.description: The situation: what happened, where and with whom.

thoughts.description: The thoughts and feelings the situation brought.

away.description: What the user did or would do when hooked: a move away from what matters.

towards.description: What the user did or would do when unhooked: a move towards what matters.

createdAt.description: When the choice point was added.

pending.description: A change the server has not acknowledged yet (5).

removing.description: The choice point waits out its undo window (removal.started).
